# Re-ground stale 2025 learn/gettingstarted/ pages and add missing H1 to CreatingYourFirstApp.md

## Context

Sub-issue of `#20498` implementing **Row 5 (`getting-started-stale`)** of the three-reader `learn/` map ([`#20498#issuecomment-6697670393`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6697670393)).

- **Ownership disposition:** `unowned-rationale: claimable leaf under #20498 per map #issuecomment-6697670393 (delegated filing by @neo-fable-mnemosyne)`

## The Problem

For a developer evaluating the engine, the second click after `benefits/Introduction.md` is `learn/gettingstarted/` (`9` pages in `learn/tree.json`). Five of the nine pages (`Setup.md`, `CreatingYourFirstApp.md`, `DescribingTheUI.md`, `Config.md`, `MainThreadAddons.md`) have not been touched since `2025-07-15`:
- `learn/gettingstarted/Setup.md` is only `3 KB` and predates the current workspace/CLI and one-command agent workflows.
- `learn/gettingstarted/CreatingYourFirstApp.md` lacks an `H1` (`# ...`) title at the top of the file.
- Several pages use 2025 class/config snippets without re-grounding against current `src/` (`Neo.setupClass`, `defineComponent` / `useConfig`, and current worker structure).

Design authority: `#20498` + `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` (Row 5 `getting-started-stale`) + `.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md` §1–§3.

## The Architectural Reality

- `learn/gettingstarted/` is the primary hands-on onboarding ramp for the **Developer Path** in `learn/README.md` and `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md`.
- Every `learn/gettingstarted/` page must be grounded against live `src/` code (`guide-authoring-bar.md` §1), carry a top-level `H1` heading, verify any `live-preview` blocks in the Portal, and convey why building in an Off-Main-Thread Application Engine is a paradigm shift over single-threaded frameworks (`guide-authoring-bar.md` §2).

## The Fix

1. Re-ground the stale `learn/gettingstarted/` pages (`Setup.md`, `CreatingYourFirstApp.md`, `DescribingTheUI.md`, `Config.md`, `MainThreadAddons.md`) against current `src/`:
   - Add the missing `H1` title to `learn/gettingstarted/CreatingYourFirstApp.md`.
   - Update `learn/gettingstarted/Setup.md` to reflect current Node/npm requirements, `npx neo-app`, zero-build native ES module `dev` mode, and cross-links to `Workspaces.md`.
   - Verify all `javascript live-preview` code blocks in `CreatingYourFirstApp.md`, `DescribingTheUI.md`, and `Config.md` render cleanly in `Neo.code.LivePreview` (or fold `gettingstarted/Config.md` if superseded by Row 4's owner table).

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback / edge case | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `learn/gettingstarted/{Setup,CreatingYourFirstApp,DescribingTheUI,Config,MainThreadAddons}.md` | `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` Row 5 + `guide-authoring-bar.md` §1–§3 | Re-ground all 2025-era Getting Started pages against current `src/`; restore missing `H1` on `CreatingYourFirstApp.md`; verify `live-preview` blocks | Coordinate `Config.md` with Row 4's owner table if folded | `learn/gettingstarted/*.md` | `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` + Portal `#/learn/gettingstarted/...` verification |

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1 (`CreatingYourFirstApp.md` H1 & Grounding):** `learn/gettingstarted/CreatingYourFirstApp.md` opens with a proper `# ...` `H1` heading and current `src/` patterns.
- [ ] **AC-2 (Re-grounded `gettingstarted/` Pages):** `Setup.md`, `DescribingTheUI.md`, `Config.md` (unless folded per Row 4), and `MainThreadAddons.md` are verified against current `src/` classes, with working `live-preview` blocks and full architectural conviction (`guide-authoring-bar.md` §1–§2).
- [ ] **AC-3 (Link & Whitespace Integrity):** `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` and `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` pass with `0` errors.

## Out of Scope

Hand-editing `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt` (`guide-authoring-bar.md` §5).

## Avoided Traps

- Calling Neo.mjs a `"framework"` (`guide-authoring-bar.md` §2).
- Flattening conviction prose (`#20518` guard).
